MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items meets a current need strongly enough for me to choose it. The locking nuts are fastening supplies, but my recent purchases concern nails, wood screws and drywall anchors, not bolt assemblies.",
    "Steel wool, grinding discs and epoxy could be useful for other projects, but buying fastening supplies does not mean I currently need surface preparation or adhesive repairs.",
    "The trash lid, pipe elbow, casters and stock tank plug require specific equipment or repair needs that my history does not establish. The bins and bulk wastebaskets also do not follow from buying replacement vacuum bags."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in any workshop or maintenance supply, although I choose items for particular tasks.",
    "Buying cleaning supplies seems to have been stretched into a need for waste containers, while buying fasteners seems to have been stretched into unrelated repair hardware."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and screw purchases make fastening materials a stronger current interest than general workshop accessories. Their dimensions, intended materials and compatibility matter to whether I can use them.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase names specific compatible Panasonic types. A matching replacement consumable would make more sense than unrelated cleaning or waste supplies.",
    "My history includes separate practical needs; the medicine cups do not imply a broader project, and neither do the vacuum bags. I need a clear use for a recommendation before choosing it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a loose maintenance theme but missed the specific fastening tasks and replacement compatibility that would make an item useful to me now."
}
